title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 12: Home

scenes.say: Newark bus station. Night. No welcome party. Just the cold air.
scenes.visual: a nearly empty bus station at night, cold breath in the air, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He pulls his duffle over his shoulder and walks into the dark streets.
scenes.visual: a man with a duffel bag walking into dark city streets, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Home didn't feel like home anymore. And I didn't feel like me anymore.
scenes.visual: a quiet Newark street at night, one light on in a window, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His mother stares from the kitchen. Silence. You look older. I feel it.
scenes.visual: a mother standing in a kitchen doorway, warm light, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a mother hugging her grown son tightly in a small kitchen, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I ain't cry in combat. But I did cry in her arms.
scenes.visual: the kitchen at night, two figures embracing in silhouette, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His old room. Same posters. Same creaky bed.
scenes.visual: a teenager's old bedroom with faded posters and a creaky bed, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He hangs Roddy's dog tags on a nail. Looks in the mirror. Doesn't recognize what he sees.
scenes.visual: dog tags hanging from a nail beside a mirror, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The boy that left this room never came back.
scenes.visual: an empty bed in a dim bedroom, streetlight through blinds, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Thirteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a porch light on a Newark rowhouse, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 12 of 25: Home. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
